title: 1602图历史使用情况未完全核实的补充评价

scientific_protocol.raw_ignore: original raster; truncate budget first; no refill; no clipping
scientific_protocol.decision: all seven per seed and C/A<=6 per seed; all three seeds mandatory; scientific failure does not cancel remaining seeds; engineering anomaly STOP
scientific_protocol.undefined_metric: not evaluable, never convert -1 to zero or PASS
scientific_protocol.statistics: paired endpoint deltas for each seed; arithmetic mean, sample SD ddof=1, worst delta; no bootstrap, p value, CI or subgroup search
scientific_protocol.official_metrics: original official-style evaluator separately; its pp units are not multiplied by 100 again
scientific_protocol.cost: same hardware and own fixed development64, independent A/B/C processes, batch4, two original-batch warmups per arm, all real views/preprocessing/mapping/NMS included; C/A<=6

claim_policy.permitted: fixed-set paired performance and measured matched-condition cost, disclosed history uncertainty; three seeds descriptive only

CPU_reuse.scope: existing development input/parsed_gt/budget/seed/partial batch/process closure/error/duplicate/export evidence; executable bytes unchanged
CPU_reuse.not_certified: future supplemental production launcher, sealed reader, checkpoint load and GPU last-batch forward

minimum_future_evaluation_access.content: exact original manifest, necessary membership/lineage, corresponding images and annotations; original three e120 EMA plus authenticated environment; existing development fixed64 for engineering/cost
minimum_future_evaluation_access.exclusions: no other test/holdout, no repartition, no new training or candidate, no original sealed records modified

optional_near_duplicate_check.needed_scope: prefer already certified perceptual fingerprints; otherwise decode all 1602 images plus core4869 and development548 only where certified fingerprints absent; no annotations required; separate approval and frozen method first
optional_near_duplicate_check.flight_site_scope: only existing image-to-flight/site/time/GPS/source mapping for these members; absence remains unknown; no image content access by default
optional_near_duplicate_check.effect: disclose unknowns; never automatically upgrade qualification

budget.caveat: historical planning estimate, may exceed; no arbitrary total wallclock cutoff; no current fresh resource observation
budget.evidence: original preparation historical A/C64 and full548 timing; no new model run

execution_readiness: plan only; future production entry and purpose/authorization binding checks required before any token; original independent guard remains unchanged
